_comment: Reference only. Run 'hyperject init' to generate a live config.json from the discovered modules. Fill targets/keys with values YOU own; the tool refuses to run against REPLACE_ placeholders.

app_insights._note: Multiple endpoints and multiple iKeys are supported (each endpoint x iKey is probed). An iKey may be a bare GUID string, or an annotated object {ikey,label} so the label shows in results. Put YOUR authorized iKeys here.

one_collector._note: Multiple endpoints and multiple keys supported. Each key = {key, ikey, origin}. If 'origin' contains 'portal' or 'login' the matching browser Origin/Referer is spoofed automatically; or set 'origin_url' explicitly. 'label' (optional) shows in results.

otlp._note: OTLP/HTTP root (real collectors listen on :4318). Signal paths /v1/traces|metrics|logs are appended. 'encoding' is 'json' or 'protobuf' (real binary OTLP via the built-in codec). Add 'headers' (e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer TEST"}) to probe an authenticated collector.

live_metrics._note: Live Metrics base = the connection string's LiveEndpoint (real: https://<region>.livediagnostics.monitor.azure.com). /QuickPulseService.svc/ping|post is appended. Use endpoints+ikeys or paste 'connection_strings'.

azmon_breeze._note: Sends the Breeze envelopes the Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry exporter emits. Use endpoints+ikeys, or paste an Azure Monitor connection string under 'connection_strings' (each carries its own ingestion endpoint + ikey). The 'covert' variant forges a Foundry gen_ai.evaluation.result MessageData.

availability_webtest._note: Control plane (ARM PUT), not ingestion: secure outcome is 401/403. Fill subscription_id/resource_group/component_id with values YOU own and set 'bearer_token' for an authorized create. Disabled by default.

prometheus_remote_write._note: Metrics receiver (real: /api/v1/write on Prometheus, Mimir, Cortex, Thanos, VictoriaMetrics). Body is Snappy-compressed protobuf (built-in codec, no deps). Add 'headers' to probe an authenticated receiver.

loki._note: Log push (real: /loki/api/v1/push). 'encoding' is 'protobuf' (Snappy-compressed logproto) or 'json'. Set 'org_id' to send an X-Scope-OrgID tenant header.

zipkin._note: Trace collector (real: /api/v2/spans, returns 202). 'encoding' is 'json' or 'protobuf' (zipkin.proto3 ListOfSpans).
